Hola, me llamo Carlos y vivo en Madrid. Cada mañana me despierto a las siete, tomo un café con pan y camino a la escuela. Mis clases de español empiezan a las nueve. Me gusta mucho estudiar idiomas con mis amigos. Por la tarde regreso a casa, leo un libro y ceno con mi familia.

Hello, my name is Carlos and I live in Madrid. Every morning I wake up at seven, have a coffee with bread, and walk to school. My Spanish classes start at nine. I really like studying languages with my friends. In the afternoon I return home, read a book, and have dinner with my family.

Today is Saturday and Ana is having dinner at a small restaurant near the square. The waiter is very kind. Ana orders a salad, chicken with rice, and a glass of cold water. The food is delicious. Afterwards, she pays the bill and returns home very happy.
